base: a47cf61c plus prior recovery-choice fix; candidate additionally bounds recovery-aware guard materialization
method: Release net10.0; two fresh processes in reversed order per comparison; 1.5 second warmup; nine alternating batches; mean of per-process medians. Inputs preconstructed; readers/streams created and fully enumerated in timed calls. Allocation samples cover three warmed calls. No concurrent builds or tests.
note: For beforeAfter, raw FixUs/FixBytes denote BEFORE and Fix44Us/Fix44Bytes denote AFTER; for currentComparison they identify the actual parsers. Small timing differences are noisy; no confidence intervals. Allocations are managed bytes per call, not retained or peak memory.
